if: the document is a receipt voucher referred to in clause (d) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 50 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the receipt voucher MUST carry the recipient's name, address and GSTIN or Unique Identity Number, where the recipient is registered
note: One mandatory particular of rule 50(d), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: name, address and Goods and Services Tax Identification Number or Unique Identity Number, if registered, of the recipient;
